source_note: PARSEC publishes no isochrone packages: the official CMD web form (https://stev.oapd.inaf.it/cgi-bin/cmd) computes isochrone tables server-side on request and is the isochrone acquisition channel (scriptable with a complete current field set, verified live 2026-10-14; complete wire documentation: docs/parsec/cmd-form.md). The host's TLS chain omits its intermediate CA (ZeroSSL RSA DV SSL CA 2); the bundled intermediate completes the chain so verification stays on.
scope_note: Registry of the form-computed products of the current fetch stage (request-layer client: stellariso.models.parsec.cmd_form): every product is the log-age half of one blueprint cell, carrying that half's exact submission fields, and the linear young-age half is archived beside it by the blueprint builder. The declared acquisition design - the full cell space the build completes towards, fetch stages and all axes - lives in stellariso.models.parsec.blueprint (docs/parsec/blueprint.md). Historical pre-2006 tracks on pleiadi.oapd.inaf.it remain out of scope.

matrix_notes.ages: log10(age/yr) 6.6-10.13 at the fine step 0.02 dex (177 isochrones per product); each cell's linear young-age half (1.0e5 to 4.0e6 yr by 1.0e5, 40 isochrones) is a blueprint-builder acquisition archived beside the log table
matrix_notes.metallicities: one product per [M/H] point of the set's designed grid (0.1 dex steps plus exact window edges; single-value jobs - the server's range arithmetic drops range end points); secondary sets are registered at their sparse initial slice (anchors -1.0, 0.0, +0.3 plus window edges) until their completion stage
matrix_notes.photometry: placeholder only: YBC UBVRIJHK for the two YBC-served sets, OBC odfnew+LSST for the six sets YBC serves no tables for (stellariso consumes the physical columns)
matrix_notes.extinction: A_V = 0 everywhere; extinction changes magnitudes only (verified 2026-10-15, docs/parsec/cmd-form.md)
matrix_notes.stage_axes: Reimers eta at 0.0/0.2/0.4 where the axis applies (canonical 0.2 where inert); initial rotation at every designed omega_i for v2.0 (11 values), 0 elsewhere; n_inTPC, circumstellar dust, and LPV prescription at their canonical values - designed axes whose remaining values are later stages
